in_marathi.name: Rashik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the Cosmos
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rashik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rashik is a Sanskrit and Hindu name meaning 'Ruler of the Cosmos'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rashtra', which means 'King' or 'Country', and 'Ishvara', which means 'God'. This name signifies the divine ruler of the universe, and is a symbol of power, wisdom, and spiritual growth.
